title: A Hunch Starts Asking to Be Tested
body:
Something you have sensed but not yet confirmed is gathering weight. Small pieces of evidence are starting to line up in one direction, and the pull to act on a hunch before it is fully proven is growing stronger.
Action: Write down what you suspect now, before it is confirmed, so you can see clearly what you knew and when.
